name: JavaScript/TypeScript code quality
source: Project-selectable baseline adapted from https://google.github.io/eng-practices/review/reviewer/looking-for.html; recommendations, not universal requirements

rules.text: Use names that communicate the role of public functions, parameters and exported values. Report a naming concern only when it creates specific ambiguity for a reader or caller, not because another name is a personal preference.
rules.exceptions: Short conventional names in a clear local context are acceptable.

rules.text: Keep control flow and abstractions understandable for the current task. Report unnecessary complexity only by identifying the concrete indirection or branching and a simpler equivalent organization; do not impose arbitrary function-length thresholds.
rules.exceptions: Additional structure is appropriate when supplied constraints explain its present purpose.

rules.text: Comments should clarify intent, constraints or non-obvious decisions. Flag a comment only when it materially misleads readers or obscures the code's intent. Do not request documentation for every symbol.
rules.exceptions: Explanatory comments may describe how unfamiliar algorithms work.
